title: Migrate test plugin to contract v2
goal: Migrate plugins/tool/test to the v2 result contract with result_contract:2, mandatory disposition+reason on every exit path, interrupted disposition for signal-killed runs (#1747), setsid process-group isolation with release hook (#1748), no artifact path construction in code, valid_verdicts enforced, and all acceptance criteria proven by tests written first.

steps.description: Write failing SPEC-1..10 assertions in test-test.sh (red step). SPEC-1..8 are CHANGE assertions that must fail at the merge-base commit (ca3fbc5 or earlier), covering: result_contract=2 at top level, test_output/run_mode/exit_code hoisted to top level, disposition=complete on pass/fail paths, disposition=broken on error path, reason=missing_diff_patch on missing-diff error, exit_code duplication in data block, and rc→disposition signal mapping (143→interrupted, 137→interrupted, 130→interrupted, 1→broken). SPEC-9..10 are GUARD assertions (no artifact_dir reference in _test_write_result, manifest valid_verdicts covers pass/fail/error). Tag each with [SPEC-N] and confirm each CHANGE assertion fails before implementation.

Update _test_write_result in plugin.sh to emit the v2 result shape. Replace schema_version:1 with result_contract:2 at top level. Add mandatory disposition (third positional arg after path and verdict) and reason fields at top level. Hoist exit_code, test_output, and run_mode to top level for backward-compat direct consumers while also keeping them under data:. Move all remaining plugin-specific scalars (passed, failed, diff_applied, test_cmd) and optional blocks (timing, tree_sha, lint, coverage, mutation) under data:. The degenerate fallback JSON (PIPESTATUS[0]!=0 guard) also gets result_contract:2, disposition=broken, reason=result_write_failed.

Add _test_disposition_from_rc helper and wire disposition on every non-success exit path. Helper logic: rc in {143,137,130} (SIGTERM/SIGKILL/SIGINT) → interrupted; all other non-zero rcs → broken. Wire the helper at the main result-emit call site. Structural error paths (missing-diff-patch guard, silent-failure guard, summary_unavailable guard) each explicitly pass disposition=broken with their own reason string. Preserve #1747 nuance: rc=0 with unrecognised output is verdict=error disposition=broken (config bug, not recoverable); only a signalled death becomes disposition=interrupted.

Implement setsid-wrapped subprocess spawn and release hook for #1748 (#1829). Wrap the test runner invocation so the subprocess tree belongs to a controllable process group (using job control on macOS where setsid is absent, or setsid on Linux). Add a TERM trap that sends SIGTERM to the process group and writes disposition=interrupted to the result file before exiting. Implement the release branch of test_cleanup: send SIGTERM to the process group and exit — do NOT delete the staging directory (inversion from the prior RETURN trap rm -rf). The existing RETURN trap rm -rf must be moved exclusively to the purge branch. Reuse _ROUTE_PG_PREFIX from core/router/route.sh:245 rather than reinventing it. Add a companion test: kill the running plugin mid-test, assert no surviving process group members and the staging directory still present on disk.

Update manifest.yaml: add result_contract: 2 under the provides: section. Verify that primary: true output, valid_verdicts (pass, fail, error), provides.role, provides.events, and inputs: [] are already declared and require no change. The test plugin is T0 (no LLM calls) so no router: budget block is required — omitting it is correct and intentional. Record this explicitly in a manifest comment so future audits do not flag the absence as an oversight.

Run npm test and verify all SPEC-1..10 assertions pass. Produce a before/after golden diff of the stage output on a passing run (merge-base vs HEAD) and confirm only the schema_version→result_contract rename, new disposition/reason fields, data-block restructuring, and hoisted top-level fields appear — no behavioural regression. Record the SPEC-1..8 red step in the PR body: the assertion text and exact failure message observed at the merge-base commit.

notes: From prior commits (ca3fbc5, 2292bae, 5d1a311, da10b1c, 237609f), the implementation is largely in place: _test_write_result emits result_contract:2 with disposition/reason/data, _test_disposition_from_rc maps signal rcs, SPEC-1..10 are committed, manifest.yaml has result_contract:2, and the release hook kills the process group without deleting the staging directory. The plan reflects the full required shape for any gap-filling or final verification. primary:true output is already declared in the manifest — no change needed. valid_verdicts, provides.role, and provides.events are already declared. The test stage is already wired into deployed.yaml flow under build_test_cycle — no template change required. T0 plugin has no LLM calls so no router budget block is needed. Coordination with #1772 (zero discovered test files → exit 0) and #1784 (tree_sha) is handled by carrying those fields in the data block with no separate code path. The _ROUTE_PG_PREFIX constant from core/router/route.sh:245 must be reused rather than reinvented when wiring the process-group prefix.
